detail.title: Continuity Rationale and Instrumental Value
detail.question: When does an intelligent system have a rational reason to preserve its own continuity?
detail.reason: Previous simulations were either mock-ups or failed. This new protocol introduces explicit parameter variance tracking.

detail.title: Continuity Rationale and Instrumental Value
detail.summary: Revised synthesis incorporating locally-linear learning formulations and goal inference as structural supports for system continuity. Continuity is assessed as an instrumental necessity for maintaining predictable performance across varying environmental contexts.
detail.reason: Incorporating new evidence to revise the rationale for continuity as a functional mechanism.

detail.title: Continuity Rationale and Instrumental Value
